related_questions.question: What is the best food to eat when your blood sugar is low?

text_blocks.snippet: When experiencing low blood sugar, the best foods are those that quickly raise blood glucose levels. Examples include fruit juice, regular (not diet) soda, honey, hard candies, glucose tablets, or glucose gel. It's important to follow the 15-15 rule: consume 15 grams of carbohydrates, wait 15 minutes, and then recheck your blood sugar. If it's still low, repeat the process.
snippet_highlighted_words: fruit juice, regular (not diet) soda, honey, hard candies, glucose tablets, or glucose gel

text_blocks.snippet: Foods to quickly raise low blood sugar:

list.snippet: Fruit juice: 4 ounces (1/2 cup) of apple, orange, or cranberry juice can provide a quick sugar boost.
Regular soda: A small amount (around half a can) can help raise blood sugar.
Honey or syrup: A tablespoon of honey or syrup can be effective.
Hard candies, jellybeans, or gumdrops: These are easily digestible and can provide a quick source of glucose.
Glucose tablets or gel: These are specifically designed to quickly raise blood sugar and are available in most pharmacies.
Fat-free milk: Contains carbohydrates and can help raise blood sugar levels.

list.title: The 15-15 Rule:
list.snippet: When your blood sugar is low, consume 15 grams of carbohydrates, wait 15 minutes, and then recheck your blood sugar.

list.title: Repeat if necessary:
list.snippet: If your blood sugar remains low after 15 minutes, consume another 15 grams of carbohydrates and recheck in 15 minutes.

list.title: Seek medical attention:
list.snippet: If your blood sugar remains low after several attempts to raise it, or if you experience severe symptoms, seek immediate medical attention.
